name: Pretty Beat
source:
A heroine of justice who fights against Horstin to avenge her best friend. She is blunt and speaks quite crudely, nonetheless she loves her friends and has a strong sense of justice and is kind at heart.

She is a virgin. Her transformation item is a bracelet called "beat bracelet" which was entrusted to her by her best friend.

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
